The 0Be alloy is the series reference: without Be addition it forms no Be–Fe phase (no reticular or Chinese-character compounds), and its rolled structure is single-phase austenite with κ-carbide, whereas the Be-bearing steels develop a banded γ + δ dual-phase structure with dispersed Be–Fe phase precipitates.
